expected.title: L2 stability of square roots of bounded positive three-dimensional Coulomb or gravitational Vlasov-Poisson solutions with mixed derivative control
expected.author: Jacky J. Chong; Laurent Lafleche; Chiara Saffirio
expected.difficulty_reason: Passing to square roots does not by itself close an L2 stability estimate for the Coulomb field. The author decomposes the singular interaction into two terms and bounds one by endpoint Lorentz control, while the other requires Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev, velocity Cauchy-Schwarz and a different spatial mixed-norm estimate. Those two source-specific closures produce the exact integrated coefficient before the routine Gronwall step, rather than treating Gronwall or the advanced equation name as the difficulty.
